en-US: Build 191 — expedited internal device testing. Both SDK app regression suites passed 204 tests; iPad and iPhone NativeNotes components passed 101 each. Two SDK27 UI automation failures remain recorded: opening a body-search result on iPad and checking the New button readiness on iPhone. The user authorized internal distribution before resolving those gates; this is not full acceptance. Test Notes content search, document covers and reopening, Pencil controls, native Office editing, and local-model chat stability. Office covers may be labelled extracted-content summaries rather than exact page layout. Also test persisted cloud-build jobs after closing and reopening the App. Use your own cloud-model credentials. Please include device, OS, model and a short reproduction in feedback.
